This time the goods which was over £30 were delivered to a random address, we have no idea where. I thought fine I will talk with Moonpig to get this sorted but I have discovered that it is impossible to talk with anyone at Moonpig, so be warned if you place an order DO NOT EXPECT it to be delivered and DO NOT expect your money back. They seem to have become a Scam business. I tried via, Safari and Google and you could not contact anyone. I am very disappointed and suggest that you DO NOT order anything from Moonpig. A very sad say for a once good business.

reviews.title: Over zealous nanny
reviews.text:
I used to enjoy Moonpig for its ease—writing part of a card in bed, finishing it later on my PC. It felt like a unobtrusive helpful assistant. Now? It’s more like an overzealous nanny who insists on choosing my stationery, correcting my tone, and offering a selection that they approve of, not taking into account my choice or preferences.  

The AI meddles with layouts, suggests messages I’d never say, and forgets that I’m the one sending the card—not a chatbot with a glitter addiction. Worse still, my devices no longer sync properly. I log in on my phone, iPad, and PC, but each behaves like it’s never met the others. Drafts vanish, edits don’t carry over, and I end up repeating myself like a confused time traveller.

Moonpig may still work for those who like quick, templated cards, but for those of us who value nuance, rhythm, and a bit of personal handwritten soul—it’s become more faff than festive. This year, I’m going back to pen, paper, and post. No AI elves, no formatting battles—just a card, a stamp, and a little peace.
